verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs say it publishes official, type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI specification, including one for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and the browser. However, the docs scope these SDKs to the Auditor API only, with no evidence of SDK coverage for the broader Manage Vanta or Build integrations APIs. missing for 10: SDK coverage beyond the Auditor API (Manage Vanta/integration APIs), evidence of the full language list and install/usage depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Vanta publishes official, type-safe SDKs for the Auditor API. Each SDK is generated from the same OpenAPI specification
Developer-friendly, fully type-safe SDK for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and the browser.
Auditor API — programmatically conduct audits in Vanta: read audit data, manage information requests
